name: hisabkikitab
description: Hisab Ki Kitab - AI-powered financial manager for university hostel students

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hisabkikitab/api" "npm run dev -w @hisabkikitab/web"
scripts.test:db: node tests/db/constraints.test.js && node tests/db/debt-transaction.test.js && node --test tests/db/shared-living.test.js
scripts.test:security: node -r dotenv/config tests/security/pentest.js dotenv_config_path=apps/api/.env && node -r dotenv/config tests/security/surface.test.js dotenv_config_path=apps/api/.env && node -r dotenv/config tests/security/auth-storage.test.js dotenv_config_path=apps/api/.env
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/api.test.js && node tests/e2e/settings.test.js && node tests/e2e/debts.test.js && node tests/e2e/refresh.test.js && node --test tests/e2e/shared-living.test.js && npm run test:browser
scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:shadowing && npm run check:dead && npm run test:unit && npm run test:web && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:db && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
